title: Finite Inflation Hierarchies and Exactness for Binary Triangle Causal Networks
banked_reason: Needs a formal weighted decomposition enumerating every admissible extension into modified old components and vertex-disjoint new components; the paper-owned Möbius-positivity core remains open after focused substrate builds and required library searches.
gap_reasons: Needs a formal weighted decomposition enumerating every admissible extension into modified old components and vertex-disjoint new components.
Existing admissible_components_do_not_merge and analytic tail lemmas are only ingredients and do not compose without that missing enumeration theorem.
The missing work is not a final local bridge: it is the graph-specific decomposition and weighted counting argument that constitutes the main new contribution.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery produced and independently reviewed an all-order rational witness, a faithful inclusion from the stronger all-AI region into the published Navascués–Wolfe region, and the quantitative bracket 1/(2048 n^6) ≤ Δ_n ≤ C n^(-1/2). Formalization proved the graph component invariance/non-merging substrate and the full AI moment factorization, but could not close the load-bearing Möbius-positivity theorem. A retry must build an explicit ExtensionCode-style weighted enumeration of all admissible extensions before reusing the completed analytic tail bounds.
tldr: No finite level of the published classical inflation hierarchy exactly characterizes binary triangle correlations. For every order \(n\), the paper constructs a rational five-support-point law \(P_n\notin T\) and a rational witness \(Q_n\) proving \(P_n\in I_n^{\mathrm{AI}}\subseteq I_n^{\mathrm{NW}}\). A weighted component-generating-function estimate proves every M\"obius atom nonnegative at \(\epsilon_n=(1024n^6)^{-1}\), giving the polynomial gap \(\Delta_n\ge1/(2048n^6)\). Published convergence gives \(\Delta_n=O(n^{-1/2})\); the sharp rate remains open.
gap: Asymptotic completeness is known, and second-order false positives are known, but the literature located does not determine whether some finite order is already exact for the classical binary triangle. The unresolved mathematical point is an all-order positive extension satisfying the actual full hierarchy convention.
fill: Prove a closed-form all-\(n\) construction: prescribe zero-event moments by admissible connected components of \(K_{n,n,n}\), establish Möbius positivity and normalization, prove the complete injectable marginal factorization, and certify observed incompatibility independently with Finner. Then isolate the sharper rate problem rather than overclaiming the exponentially small gap as optimal.
